# Doug's Dharma Video Index

> A searchable index of 625 educational videos on early Buddhism
> by Doug Smith (Doug's Dharma YouTube channel).

## About

Doug's Dharma is a YouTube channel created in 2017 to introduce the
teachings of early Buddhism to a wide audience. Doug Smith holds a PhD
in Philosophy of Mind and has published scholarly works in Buddhist Studies.
This index covers videos from March 2017 to September 2026.
An overview of all his work (courses, essays, book, articles) is at
https://dougsdharma.com/llms.txt

## Browse Pages

Plain HTML pages (no JavaScript needed), each listing its videos newest first
with date, summary and watch URL:
- Topic hub: https://videos.dougsdharma.com/topics/ (one page per topic with 3+ videos, linked below)
- Sutta hub: https://videos.dougsdharma.com/suttas/ (one page per text cited in 3+ videos, linked below)
- URL pattern: https://videos.dougsdharma.com/topics/<slug>.html and https://videos.dougsdharma.com/suttas/<slug>.html,
  e.g. https://videos.dougsdharma.com/suttas/mn-10.html

## Structured Data

The complete video index is available in several machine-readable forms:
- Normalized JSON (recommended): https://videos.dougsdharma.com/videos.json
- Flat Markdown list: https://videos.dougsdharma.com/videos.md
- Full source JSON (richest, with refs): https://videos.dougsdharma.com/dougs_dharma_index.json
- Searchable web interface: https://videos.dougsdharma.com/

Each video in videos.json contains:
- id (YouTube video id), title, url (canonical watch URL), date, description
- topics (from a controlled vocabulary of 242 terms)
- suttas (early Buddhist text references, e.g. "MN 10", "SN 56.11")

The source file (dougs_dharma_index.json) additionally includes sutta_refs
with SuttaCentral URLs, other_refs (books/articles), and related_videos.

## Sutta References

This index references 554 unique suttas from the Pali canon
and other early Buddhist texts. References use standard abbreviations
(DN, MN, SN, AN, etc.) and link to SuttaCentral.net translations.
Texts cited in 3+ videos have their own page; all 554 are on the sutta hub.
